scaleEvidence: Both outputs are nearest samples from new high-detail raw generated sources, not an upscale of old sprites or of the 640 output. Higher source sampling detail does not prove an authored native pixel grid.
flipAnchorRule: Mirror entire actor+weapon local group. For a separately mirrored rect use rect.width - anchor.x and rect.width - hand.x; keep Y and reverse angle consistently.
weaponLayerRule: Draw body, weapon transformed around weapon.pivot at frame.weapon.hand, then redraw each original body handOcclusionRects region to preserve closed fingers over the grip. Legacy single handOcclusionRect is the primary grip; released props use an empty rect. Body images are genuinely generated weaponless; no importer masking repair.
